notes: Kable 3.1.1 is a robustness and security revision on top of 3.1.0. It blocks a paired device from reaching the internal control routes, repairs receiving when a trust reload fails, and bounds clipboard input, abandoned inbound records and sender stalls. Settings and save-folder changes now apply in order, inbound transfers are attributed to the TLS-verified sender, and receiver-lifecycle and address-selection bugs are fixed. No pairing, protocol or file-format change: existing pairings and settings carry over, same release key, in-place update. No new features. Real-phone testing was not possible for this build; the full automated suite passed.
